{{Scorpio}}
Scorpio 24 is the 332nd day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 24th day of Scorpio, and it is a Wednesday. It corresponds to ISO week 48, weekday 3.

Its informal Japanese name is 12宮24日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 332|Chapter 332]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152351}}.
